data.headline: Admission requirements
data.text:
Successful completion of a university degree in a relevant degree course with a minimum final qualification of Bachelor with an overall grade of at least 2.5, as well as compliance with the additional admission requirements listed below.

A degree course is relevant if it contains at least 80 ECTS credits in computer science or information science content.
Further information on the application process and the template for listing the required ECTS can be found at www.digital-sciences.de.

The degree of relevance of the Bachelor's degree is determined depending on the chosen field of study.

An application is already possible if you have not yet completed your degree course, but are expected to complete them before the start of the Master's degree programme.
